description: This file defines and exports theme-related functions for a frontend application. It provides functionality to set the current theme (currently only supporting dark theme) and retrieve the current theme from the document's HTML attributes. It also re-exports theme constants and functions from an external local module.

methods.name: setTheme(themeName = "dark")
methods.description: Sets the current theme by name, defaulting to 'dark'. Internally calls 'applyDarkTheme' when themeName is 'dark'.

methods.name: getCurrentTheme()
methods.description: Returns the current theme from the document's 'data-theme' attribute. Defaults to 'dark' if not set or if 'document' is undefined.
